sram_client_owner.client_1: P0 source read or P1 sink write

trial.stored_origin: P1 block.io_rsp_valid[1] following the accepted destination write

integrated_top.required: Select and pin a two-instance RTL or netlist and matching views; specify instance IDs and reset ownership.

fixed_control.required: Bind MC/LC command and return paths, LC/native adapter ports and the PM deployment interlock.

private_s.required: Freeze private S variant, banks, address width, host/TX/RX/write-client ownership and store commit port.

intra_block_data.required: Choose stored replay or direct M-to-G; pin endpoints, Q format, widths, buffering and the return handshake.

cross_block_data.required: Bind actual P0.TX to P1.RX, source and sink pins, framing, single writer, ready/valid, buffering and clock domains.

cross_block_ack.required: Bind actual P1 write-completion to P0 release, ACK identity and encoding, edge ID, backpressure, timeout and clock domains.

images_and_data.required: Pin production image versions, capacity ID, topology ID, native ABI, preloads and source/mirror reference hashes.

a4_required: Production reset/quiesce certificate, epoch/generation ownership, stale response flush, and CDC behavior where used.
a5_required: Same-version integrated netlist and views, SDC, routed M1-M12 parasitics including selected upper-metal overlay, clock/reset assumptions and signed setup/hold/electrical reports.
production_note: RTL candidate implemented and verified separately; seven production bindings await same-version physical/PM acceptance.
